svg.text: Member 1: 390 of SHS; member 2: 265 of SHS, welded at a right

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: angle at one end of member 1, pointing toward the pit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two fork plates 115 x 66 x 8 under the end of member 2, 50 apart

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inside, each with a 16.5 hole 26 up from the bottom, in line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Member 1 lies on the tower top plate: two 10.5 holes 100 apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld all round; full fillets on the fork plates (screw load 3.8 kN).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: bolts on the tower top with 2 M10; the upper trunnion block

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hangs between the fork plates on two 16 pins.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the two fork holes line up with a 16 bar through both.
